pages.title: File:'First Enclosure Bookie Ring' closed on Indian Derby day -2019.JPG

ObjectName.value: 'First Enclosure Bookie Ring' closed on Indian Derby day -2019

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Mahalaxmi Racecourse|Self-published work

ImageDescription.value: BOOKMAKERS TRADING RING IN FIRST ENCLOSURE" :-  Unbelievable ghastly sight of a "Bookmakers Shamshanghat(Graveyard)" on "Kingfisher Ultra Indian Derby Day 2019 ". The entire "Bookmakers Betting Ring" has been sealed by the Police and Income Tax officials  and closed since that ghastly Friday the 21st day of 2018. On a "Indian Derby Day" lakhs  of rupees are bet  and either won or lost by punters and bookies. Its a "Cat and Mouse" game between punters and bookies a eternal "Tom & Jerry " saga of  real life money chase. Betting is what defines and keeps the sport of "HORSE RACING" relevant and alive unlike most other sports .The betting for the derby  was only on the racecourse managed "Tote" betting system. A First in the history of the Indian Derby in India.

UsageTerms.value: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
